purpose: External official-source provenance for Phase 2, recast into the frozen SourceEntry shape.
whyNotInBundle: These are remote VCS repositories that have not been fetched to this machine. The frozen SourceEntry contract requires sourceUri+commit+treeRef+entrypoint to describe a source the runner can actually consume; recording them as bundle modules would claim a runnable source that is not on disk.
They therefore mirror the existing provenanceArchives pattern: pinned as provenance/evidence, inBundle=false, and NOT passed to validateSourceBundle as baseline/modules.
Their runnerCompatibility is recorded per entry so the profile can make an explicit preflight decision instead of discovering it at import time.
contractNote: Every entry below was passed through the frozen validateSourceEntry from packages/evolver/src/contracts/experiments.ts. Fields outside the closed SourceEntry key set (officiality, runnerCompatibility, reason, verifiedAt, tier, paper) are carried in the sibling metadata object for each entry, never inside the SourceEntry itself.
